reason: The README presents intent-gate primarily as a requirements-planning workflow that analyzes PRDs, resolves ambiguities with human input, produces Mermaid-based technical contracts, persists review state, and lints the result before coding begins.

summaries.zh: 一个通过分析需求文档、澄清歧义并生成经过检查的 Mermaid 技术契约来帮助编码代理在编程前完成意图对齐的 MCP 插件。
summaries.en: An MCP plugin that helps coding agents align with requirements before implementation by analyzing PRDs, resolving ambiguities, and generating linted Mermaid-based technical contracts.

capabilities: Reads UTF-8 text files and DOCX requirement documents
Asks structured human questions to resolve requirement gaps
Generates Mermaid state machines, sequence diagrams, and decision tables
Persists review artifacts and question resolutions to project files
Runs mechanical lint checks on generated requirement contracts
Provides an MCP server for compatible coding-agent clients
